messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Hosted API (us-east) request-queue spike. backlog=8200 reqs, p95=2.8s, p99=12.4s, gpu_util=98% on hosted-gpu-pool-12. Provisioner errors: 429 from cloud API. Paging @alice-sre.

alice-sre: Acknowledged. I'm oncall — will triage. tagging @carla-eng and @ben-ops for autoscaler/provisioner.

carla-eng: Looking at provisioner logs now. seeing burst of `CreateInstance` 429s. excerpt:```ProvisionerService ERROR 11:22:34: CreateInstance failed: QuotaExceeded: Rate limit exceeded for project X. Retrying... 429``` Also some warmup failures: `failed to attach GPU` but mainly quota.

ben-ops: Confirmed cloud side is returning rate-limit on the VM create API. Looks like our provisioner loop is hammering the quota in several AZs. Opening emergency quota escalation with cloud support now.

alice-sre: Short-term mitigations: 1) enable routing failover to dedicated pools for high-tier customers 2) enable model-variant fallback to smaller quantized models 3) reduce max_batch_tokens to lower latency and allow more concurrency. Who can flip routing quickly?

carla-eng: I can flip routing. Plan: add routing rule that sends 20% of hosted traffic to `dedicated-fallback-pool` and 100% for enterprise traffic if provisioner errors persist. Patch snippet:```routes:
  - match: {tier: enterprise}
    to: dedicated-fallback-pool
  - match: {traffic: emergency-shift}
    to: hosted-gpu-pool-12-quantized
    weight: 20
``` Applying now.

ben-ops: Quota ticket submitted (INC-4729) — cloud support says ~15-30m to approve in expedited channel. Meanwhile I can manually spin up a few reserve instances in a different project account and wire them to `dedicated-fallback-pool`. Starting that.

david-support: From support side: two enterprise customers reported timeouts (~5m) at 11:18. We sent initial note: "Experiencing degraded latency on hosted API, investigating. ETA unknown." We should update status page if customers will see >10min impact.

alice-sre: Agreed. I'll draft status page update after we confirm mitigation progress.

carla-eng: Model-fallback ramped: enabled `gptq-7b` variant for low-latency route; decreased default `max_batch_tokens` from 4096 -> 2048 on the hosted path. Command run:```redwoodctl routing set-weight --from hosted-api --to gptq-7b --weight 0.25 && redwoodctl config set hosted-api.max_batch_tokens=2048``` Responses look ok.

incident-bot: Action: routing rule applied by carla-eng at 11:28, config change by carla-eng at 11:29.

carla-eng: Quick telemetry: backlog dropping: 8200 -> 1400 in 6m after fallback. p95 now ~480ms, p99 trending down from 12.4s -> 1.9s. GPU util on hosted-gpu-pool-12 still high but less queue pressure.

ben-ops: Reserve instances up and joined `dedicated-fallback-pool` at 11:34. Provisioner still getting some 429s but we're not blocking on it now.

alice-sre: Good. I'm going to do a handoff to night oncall. @ben-ops please take incident for next 2 hours and continue escalation with cloud support; I'll reassign after.

ben-ops: Taking it. Will monitor queue, autoscaler logs, and the cloud ticket. If quota isn't increased, we'll keep traffic on dedicated fallback and prepare runbook for capacity plan. :thumbsup:

david-support: Posting status update now: "Investigating increased latency for hosted API in us-east. Mitigations applied; some customers routed to fallback. Working on capacity, will provide updates."

eva-product: Any impacted experiments or internal jobs we should pause to relieve load?

carla-eng: Yes — pausing non-critical internal batch eval jobs in us-east for 30m. patched:```kubectl scale deployment eval-runner --replicas=0 -n dev-eval``` 

alice-sre: Handing off full timeline and notes to @ben-ops in the channel: what we changed, why, and follow-ups: 1) Cloud quota escalation (owner: ben-ops) 2) Postmortem to identify burst origin + autoscaler backoff tuning (owner: carla-eng) 3) Status page follow-up (owner: david-support) 4) Capacity insurance: pre-warmed standby in different projects (owner: infra-policy).

ben-ops: Acknowledged. I'll keep thread updated every 15m. Next update in 15.

carla-eng: quick telemetry update at 11:50: backlog ~600, p95 ~320ms, p99 ~720ms. Still keeping gptq-7b fallback enabled and dedicated pool handling enterprise traffic.

incident-bot: Cloud ticket INC-4729 updated by ben-ops: support escalated, estimated wait 18m.

ben-ops: Cloud approved temporary quota bump at 12:06, provisioner resumed creates, we scaled up 6 nodes into hosted-gpu-pool-12. Backlog drained to ~120 by 12:12.

carla-eng: Rolling back temporary routing: reduce weight to 0.05 to minimize cost and flip enterprise back to hosted primary. Will monitor.

alice-sre: All good — p95/p99 back to normal ranges p95=210ms p99=480ms. Closing active pager. We'll keep the follow-ups and schedule a postmortem. Thanks team. :heart:

david-support: Customer update: "Issue resolved. Some requests may have experienced degraded latency earlier today; full postmortem will be shared."

ben-ops: Taking incident to monitoring state. Handoff notes saved. Follow-up owners: ben-ops (quota escalation review), carla-eng (autoscaler backoff + routing playbook), infra-policy (standby pre-warm design), david-support (customer comms).

incident-bot: Pager cleared at 12:20 by alice-sre."
